subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command now, or fold fallback-chain verification into the broader `models status --probe --all` or staged model migration workflow?
rationale: The missing behavior is concrete, but it adds a new command surface that overlaps existing auth probes and two open model-health/migration feature requests, so automation should not choose the permanent UX shape.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow fallback-chain probe
options.body: Add a first-class command that starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports the responding model while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

options.title: Fold into broader probe UX
options.body: Track this behavior under the broader per-model health-check or staged migration workflow so users get one diagnostic path instead of another command.

options.title: Defer core command
options.body: Keep current auth/status probes as-is until maintainers decide proactive fallback validation belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow fallback-chain probe
recommendation.body: Add a first-class command that starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports the responding model while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the clearest product-scope review and has recent model status/fallback history.
